execution_scope: Read-only source review, existing local test suite, and in-memory synthetic exploit probes. No network, live auth, Postgres, migration, deployment, source mutation, student data, or feature flag access.

authority_context.note: The initial MissionMed OS authority blockers were snapshot-time findings during root recovery. DR-006 and PR #12 address those blockers. The application P0/P1 findings below remain current until repaired and retested.

results.vector: A read_only actor lists item_revisions through the generic resource contract.
results.observed: The returned revision contains answer and explanation fields.
results.expected: General read roles receive no answer-bearing revision fields.

results.vector: A read_only actor requests the post-answer artifact while supplying phase=post_answer_finalized.
results.observed: The answer-bearing debrief is returned without authoritative duel state or participant proof.
results.expected: Server proves finalized state and participant membership.

results.vector: Pre-answer payload contains nested answer_map and is_correct aliases.
results.expected: Closed-world validator rejects both aliases and all equivalent answer secrets.

results.vector: An unassigned physician role writes and updates rights_records through generic create/update.
results.observed: The rights state is accepted without owner workflow or authority proof.
results.expected: Rights, privacy, evidence, and source eligibility use dedicated owner-authorized workflows.

results.vector: Platform admin submits a medical review as a claimed physician using an editorial assignment.
results.observed: Admin impersonation and assignment review-type mismatch are accepted.
results.expected: Authenticated actor equals assigned reviewer and event type equals assignment type.

results.vector: One admin self-registers, holds both governance slots, enables student release, and performs all promotions.
results.observed: The same actor reaches published with no validator evidence, medical attestation evidence, or Brian ratification field.
results.expected: Separate immutable authority steps with evidence and Brian ratification.

results.vector: Database policies trust app.actor_id and comma-separated app.actor_roles settings.
results.observed: No trusted setter, auth.uid binding, signature, or transaction-local adapter is defined.
results.expected: Canonical server-derived actor context that application callers cannot forge.

results.vector: Any non-null actor context selects nearly every table.
results.observed: No ownership, assignment, phase, release, or data-class predicate protects answer/review/artifact rows.
results.expected: Deny-default row and column boundaries with assignment-scoped access.

results.vector: Cookie-backed canonical integration would expose mutations without I1Q CSRF validation; expiry/revocation behavior is unproved.
results.observed: I1Q has no CSRF/origin gate. Inspected HQ source warns but returns expired session payloads; live parity was not tested.
results.expected: Canonical CSRF, expiry, revocation, logout, fixation, and outage controls pass.

results.vector: Every required privacy class has one gold label and zero detections.
results.observed: Aggregate status and every class status report pass with recall zero.
results.expected: Threshold failure, including patient and student-name recall floors.

results.vector: Normalized in-memory segment retains raw text beside redacted text.
results.observed: Raw text remains available to accidental logs, serialization, or downstream writes.
results.expected: Only privacy-safe working text crosses the restricted-to-working boundary.

results.vector: Candidate SQL is promoted toward preview as 0001_i1q_question_platform.sql.
results.observed: Filename/header violate MR-078A; trigger, policy, and constraint creation is not repeat-safe; no Postgres run exists.
results.expected: New canonical timestamped forward migration with preview evidence.

results.vector: Compensating SQL toggles database flags and inserts a standalone audit event.
results.observed: Running app does not read DB flags; audit predecessor is null; digest dependency is undeclared; no rollback/reapply run exists.
results.expected: Authoritative flag coupling, continuous audit chain, prior-release re-promotion, rollback and reapply proof.

results.vector: Projected IDs fall back to array ordinal and lookup keys use bare question_id.
results.observed: IDs can shift and duplicates can overwrite; release snapshot omits exact identity tuples.
results.expected: Persistent opaque composite mapping and exact release membership.

results.vector: Candidate drills artifact is supplied to current consumers.
results.observed: It lacks video, title, playback, nodes, transcript/VTT availability, rights, privacy, hashes, and remediation timestamps.
results.expected: Versioned read-only adapter with explicit availability and consumer-specific validation.

results.vector: Exact nine-field row and frozen STAT hash vector.
Search candidate runtime code for a live answer_map query.
results.observed: No live answer_map query exists in candidate code.
30 passed and 0 failed, but the suite does not cover the confirmed exploit paths or real SQL/auth integration.
results.expected: Existing tests pass plus new negative security coverage.
